daylight.title: Daylight is short
daylight.body: December and January have the shortest days—roughly nine hours between sunrise and sunset. Plan outdoor activities for the morning. By late afternoon the light is already golden. Use it.

layers.title: Layer up
layers.body: The coast might be 18°C while Troodos is 5°C. Bring a windproof jacket, a warm mid-layer, and a hat. Mountain cafés have fireplaces. Coastal tavernas have heaters. Dress for both.

book-ahead.title: Book winery tastings ahead
book-ahead.body: Many wineries run small operations. In winter they appreciate a call or online booking. You'll often get the owner or winemaker pouring. Worth the extra step.

weekday-quiet.title: Weekdays are quieter
weekday-quiet.body: Omodos, Lefkara, and the main sites fill up on weekends. Tuesday or Wednesday? You'll have the cobbles to yourself. Villages feel different when the tour buses have gone. Plan big days for midweek.

kafenion-stop.title: Stop for a coffee
kafenion-stop.body: Village kafenions are where locals meet. Order a Greek coffee, sit, watch. No rush. In winter the stove is lit and the pace is slow. The person at the next table often knows the best winery, trail, or taverna. The best advice isn't in a guidebook.

winter-light.title: The light is different
winter-light.body: Winter sun stays low in the sky. Golden hour comes early—often mid-afternoon in December. Ancient sites, villages, the coast: everything looks different. Bring a camera. Or just watch. Plan ruins and villages for the afternoon and you'll see why.

start-early.title: Start by 9am
start-early.body: Winter days are short—finish hikes well before dusk. The morning air is crisp. The trails are quieter early. You'll thank yourself when you're back at the car with daylight to spare.

check-conditions.title: Check before you go
check-conditions.body: Troodos weather changes fast. Snow on Olympus, mud after rain, ice on shaded sections. The ski resort posts conditions. So do local cafés. Ask. Don't assume.

microspikes.title: Microspikes for Olympus
microspikes.body: Olympus Summit and higher Troodos trails can have snow and ice from January to March. Microspikes cost €20 and fit over your boots. If the forecast is near freezing, bring them.

tell-someone.title: Tell someone your route
tell-someone.body: Phone signal is patchy in the mountains. Tell your hotel or a friend which trail you're on and when you expect back. Emergency: 112. The mountain doesn't care about your deadline.

euro.title: Euro, cards, and cash
euro.body: Cyprus uses the euro. Cards work almost everywhere. Small village shops and kafenions sometimes prefer cash. Keep €20 or so for coffee, lace, and zivania.

drive-left.title: Drive on the left
drive-left.body: British legacy. Rent a car if you want to reach villages and trails. The roads are good. Mountain bends can be tight. Take your time. The views are worth it.

emergency.title: Emergency numbers
emergency.body: 112 for EU emergency. 1460 for tourist information. 199 for ambulance. Save them. Hope you never need them.

Artemis est la boucle plus douce autour de Chionistra quand les crêtes gardent la neige ; Atalante est une randonnée d'une journée de 14 km — partez tôt quand c'est sans glace. Caledonia Falls débite fort après la pluie.

header.description: Comment nous collectons, utilisons et protégeons vos données. Dernière mise à jour : mars 2026.

s1.title: 1. Who we are
s1.body: Cyprus Winter ("we", "us", "our") is a tourism information and trip-planning service. This privacy policy explains how we process your personal data when you use our website and services.

s2.title: 2. Data we collect and how we use it
s2.intro: We collect the following data, for the purposes and legal bases stated below:

items.conversion: Conversion and usage data (session ID, path, user-agent, event name): to understand how the service is used and improve it. Legal basis: Legitimate interest.
items.booking: Booking data (email, name, experience and date): to process winery and guide booking requests and communicate with you. Legal basis: Contract performance.
items.trailReports: Trail reports (note, optional email): to display crowd-sourced trail conditions. Legal basis: Legitimate interest; consent where email is provided.
items.chat: Chat messages: when you use Ask AI, your messages and context are sent to AI providers (OpenAI, xAI, Groq, Moonshot) to generate responses. Legal basis: Legitimate interest.
items.localPrefs: Préférences locales (intérêts, régions, plan) : stockées uniquement dans votre navigateur. Non envoyées à nos serveurs sauf pour certaines fonctions (ex. liens de partage de plan).

s3.title: 3. Data processors and transfers
s3.intro: We use the following processors to operate the service:

processors.supabase: Supabase — database and storage (conversion events, bookings, trail reports)
processors.ai: AI providers — OpenAI, xAI, Groq, Moonshot — for Ask AI chat responses

s3.transfers: Data may be transferred to countries outside the EU. We rely on adequacy decisions or appropriate safeguards (e.g. Standard Contractual Clauses) where required.

items.bookings: Bookings: As needed for booking follow-up and legal obligations (typically up to 2 years after the experience date).
items.trailReports: Trail reports: Indefinitely, unless you request deletion (see below).
items.chat: Chat messages: Not stored long-term; processed in real time by AI providers per their policies.

s5.title: 5. Your rights (GDPR)

rights.complaint: Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority

s5.outro: To exercise these rights, contact us at the email below. For data linked to a booking, include the email address used. For trail reports, include the email if you provided one. We will respond within 30 days.

s6.title: 6. Cookies and similar technologies
s6.intro: We use cookies and local storage for:

categories.essential: Essentiel : Session, préférences, plan de voyage et métriques de tunnel en premier parti nécessaires aux réservations (vues de page, ajout au plan, début de réservation). Elles restent sur nos serveurs.

s6.outro: You can manage cookie preferences via the cookie banner or your browser settings. Essential cookies cannot be disabled without limiting functionality.

s7.title: 7. Security
s7.body: We use HTTPS, secure storage, and follow industry best practices. We do not log or store PII in client-side analytics beyond what is strictly necessary.

s8.title: 8. Changes
